tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a sublinear response to u_now, but the bridge note points to a two-layer mechanism whose behavior cannot be identified from five rows with all other inputs fixed. The open-branch probe can discriminate candidate mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating response to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, so the dependence on other inputs and the bridge mechanism is not identifiable.
The cheaper branch-discriminating probe is more directly relevant to identifying the mechanism.
It is unrelated to the identified mechanism ambiguity.
